correctness.summary: The spherical-mean ODE fixes the derivative sign inside the unit translation radius, direct differentiation fixes it outside, and the critical p=2-n case is exactly the Newton-shell profile. The touching-sphere beta integral supplies the sharp integrability threshold p>1-n.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2018 source gives only the local translation second-variation threshold. Searches of weighted-perimeter, translated-ball, spherical-mean/Riesz-kernel and current 2026 literature did not locate the complete profile. Classical spherical-mean and Newton-shell facts are explicitly excluded from the novelty claim.

value.summary: The result gives a complete translation phase diagram, upgrades local stability to global stability among origin-containing ball translates in the stable-but-not-global range, and identifies a critical continuum of equal-perimeter translates.

limitations: Only translations of a fixed Euclidean ball are classified.
The global isoperimetric problem for arbitrary competitors is not changed.
The p=2-n identity itself is classical Newton-shell potential theory.
Equivalent prior coverage in Riesz-potential terminology remains a residual originality risk.
Independent audit has not been performed.
review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.
